guarantees.claim: The bus integrity error output (intg_err_o) from hmac_reg_top instance u_reg is directly driven onto alerts[0].
The TL register window output (tl_win_o) from u_reg is directly driven onto the wire tl_win_h2d.
The alert_test signal is assigned the bitwise AND of reg2hw.alert_test.q and reg2hw.alert_test.qe, enclosed in a redundant concatenation.

assumptions.claim: reg2hw.alert_test.q and reg2hw.alert_test.qe must have equal bit widths for the bitwise AND to be meaningful and avoid truncation or width-mismatch warnings.
assumptions.risk: If widths differ, alert_test may be driven with only a subset of bits, potentially causing untested or falsely triggered alert paths.

uncertain_points.claim: The use of a single-element concatenation in the alert_test assignment may mask a width mismatch if alert_test is wider than the bitwise-AND result; the actual width driven may be only 1 bit.
uncertain_points.cond: if alert_test is declared with a width greater than 1
uncertain_points.risk: alert_test could drive only the LSB, leaving upper bits floating or undriven, leading to incomplete alert test coverage or synthesis/simulation mismatches.
